prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for an original sci-fi wilderness survival test kit inspired by the broad frontier-survival atmosphere of CryoFall. Original designs, no game logos or directly copied assets. Style: premium crisp flat vector illustration, sculpted clean closed silhouettes, restrained thick dark charcoal-blue outlines, limited 2-tone flat cel shading, no gradients, no painterly texture, no pixel art, no photorealistic or 3D rendering, adult proportions with slightly enlarged heads and readable equipment. Unified palette: charcoal #25343b, desaturated olive #737f55, warm sand #d3bd8d, rust orange #be6d45, teal #60aaad, ivory #eee2c6. Lighting from upper left. Actual transparent alpha background, no paper, no checkerboard painted into the image, no colored backdrop, no ground plane, no floor shadows, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Every sprite must be completely separated with generous clear alpha padding, all content fully inside its cell. Create a square 1536 x 1536 sprite sheet, EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows, SIX equally sized cells each 512x768. One complete standing human per cell centered precisely at x=256,768,1280 and row centers y=384,1152. Same character scale approx 560px tall, feet aligned near y=680 and1448. Slight elevated 3/4 game perspective, almost frontal facing camera and a little to viewer's right, relaxed arms separated slightly from torso for readable cutout silhouette. Six different original adult survivor characters. Reading order: (1) tan-skinned male scout with olive tee, cargo trousers, belt, brown boots, small rust neck scarf, unarmed; (2) dark-skinned female field medic with teal field jacket, cream trousers, belt pouches, medical satchel, hair tied back, unarmed; (3) pale red-haired mechanic in rust coveralls, tool belt, cream gloves, steel goggles resting on forehead, unarmed; (4) olive-armored ranger with dark tactical vest, olive helmet, knee pads, compact backpack, both hands empty; (5) expedition researcher in cream and yellow sealed protective suit, round transparent visor, dark gloves and boots, small teal canisters, hands empty; (6) cold-biome explorer in thick sand parka with ivory fur collar, navy snow trousers, backpack, padded gloves, hands empty. Great variety but unified art direction and proportions. No weapons covering the bodies. No extra floating objects. Exactly six figures.
